title: Difficult airway history documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports previous-anesthesia history, medical therapy, focused examination, airway and physical-condition assessment, and factors affecting perioperative risk.
user_facing_items.population: Patients receiving anesthesia care, with emergency modification permitted.
restrictions: Exact for record review, patient interview, focused examination, previous anesthesia and medical therapy, risk-relevant physical condition, tests, consultations, consent, and documentation. UAE policy and emergency modifications remain local responsibilities.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact ASA standard supports documenting previous anesthesia history and focused airway examination; it does not declare a difficult airway or select a management strategy.
